about_the_game:
Relax to the comfy and cozy atmosphere and master the games Physics to strategically match items until you make a nuclear ball without running out of space in ​this new hit action puzzle game! How many nuclear balls can you merge?

Suika Puffworks is a casual and addictive game where the goal is to stack and combine items of different sizes and physics to create larger items. The game mechanics resemble a "match-3" style, but with a fun twist where the items fall and roll across the screen with dynamic physics.

In the game, items appear at the top of the screen to be dropped in by your cute and friendly bear worker. When two items of the same type touch, they merge to form a larger item which may have different physics. For example, two apples combine to form a clock, two clock combine to form TNT, and so on, until they form a Nuclear Ball. The challenge lies in managing the growing stack of items without letting them overflow the game area while gaining enough points to smash the leaderboards.

Simple and relaxing gameplay, perfect for players looking for a light and fun pastime.
